facts.claim: TXN reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.463B, up 23% year over year; Analog revenue was $4.365B, up 26%, and Embedded Processing revenue was $788M, up 16%.
Trailing-12-month operating cash flow was $8.667B; capital expenditures were $3.312B; CHIPS Act incentive proceeds were $1.179B; company-defined free cash flow was $6.534B, or 33.6% of revenue.

Q2 gross margin rose to 61.4% from 57.9% a year earlier despite higher manufacturing costs associated with planned capacity expansions; the filing states higher factory loadings spread fixed costs over increased output and generally increase profit margins absent other circumstances.

TXN entered an agreement to acquire Silicon Labs for approximately $7.5B enterprise value, expected to close in the first half of 2027 subject to approvals; a delayed-draw facility provides up to $5B of borrowing capacity for the transaction.

Reuters independently reported that TXN's Q3 revenue outlook exceeded the then-current analyst consensus and tied demand strength to analog chips, AI/data-center investment, and recovery in industrial and automotive markets.

risks.risk: The Silicon Labs acquisition adds regulatory, financing and integration risk and may increase leverage if completed as planned.
Capacity economics remain utilization-sensitive: planned manufacturing expansion raises fixed-cost exposure if industrial, automotive or data-center demand weakens.

unknowns.unknown: Current market valuation and peer-relative valuation are not established by this Scout source package and remain Alpha underwriting work.
Incremental return on each new 300mm fab and forward utilization by facility are not quantified sufficiently here for a numeric underwriting conclusion.

note: Scout supplies source-addressed facts only; no numeric underwriting or canonical score judgment is made. SEC regulatory origin and Reuters publisher origin are materially distinct from the previously represented issuer:TXN:2026Q2 origin.
